battery_v.rationale: Positive terminal voltage for a functioning battery-powered reporting device. A generous 5 V ceiling is an engineering guard for the single-cell battery context, not a bound fitted to the observed 3.x–4.x V samples. Team 25 contains eleven zero readings treated as invalid.

temp_c.rationale: Assumed outdoor-electronics operating envelope, allowing freezing weather and substantial heating beyond the samples. Team 25 has three -127 C suspected error placeholders, outside this envelope. No particular temperature-sensor datasheet was supplied.

rings_per_day.rationale: A count/rate cannot be negative. A deliberately generous ceiling assumes one independently debounced event per second for 24 hours, far beyond a busy doorway. The debounce ceiling is an explicit operating assumption, not a measured sensor specification.

wifi_rssi_dbm.rationale: A broad assumed received-Wi-Fi signal envelope allows much weaker and stronger signals than the sample. Team 25 has ten zero RSSI placeholders. Zero dBm is not universally impossible in radio physics; it is excluded as an invalid received-doorbell reading under this log interpretation.

age_months.rationale: Service age cannot be negative; 240 months allows twenty years, much longer than the observed service ages. Twenty years is an explicit, generous service-life assumption, not a property inferred from the CSV.
